cards.title: Separation of Variability and Uncertainty in Simulations
cards.claim: Between-unit variability (IIV) must be distinguished from parameter estimation uncertainty. A fitted parameter standard error is not an individual variability distribution. Human IIV cannot be inferred from animal data or parameter SEs without a stated basis.
conditions: When constructing Monte Carlo simulation inputs.
When translating animal PK to human scenarios.
When defining the 'probability' component of PTA.
required_inputs: Explicit definition of parameter uncertainty (if propagated).
limitations: Group means do not provide individual trajectories.
Technical replicates do not increase biological n.
Animal variability does not automatically translate to human IIV.
cards.downstream_use: Valid Monte Carlo simulation setup; interpretation of PTA confidence intervals.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
